title: Await a Sequence
prompt:
A fake API is provided: `api.loadUser()` returns a promise resolving to { name: "Ada" }, and `api.loadGreeting(name)` returns a promise resolving to "Hello, <name>".

1. Write an async function `run()` that awaits loadUser, then awaits loadGreeting with the user's name, and logs the final greeting.
2. Call run().

tests.name: logs the awaited greeting
tests.hint: async function run() { const user = await api.loadUser(); const greeting = await api.loadGreeting(user.name); console.log(greeting); }

tests.name: uses await (not .then chains or raw promises)
tests.hint: The await keyword is the point of this exercise — no .then chains.
